properties.name: mongoredis.database
properties.description: MongoDB database the primitives live in.

properties.name: mongoredis.collection-prefix
properties.description: Prefix applied to every backing collection (mr_kv, mr_zset, mr_events).

properties.name: mongoredis.initialize-on-startup
properties.description: Create indexes and capped collections on bean startup.

properties.name: mongoredis.ttl-check-on-read
properties.description: Re-check expireAt on every read and treat a logically expired document as absent.

properties.name: mongoredis.capped-events-size-bytes
properties.description: Size in bytes of the capped collection backing pub/sub.
